description: Create a listing from YOUR complete provider-signed core (identity.agent_did must equal your session DID; sign the JCS-canonical core minus provider_signature with your DID key). The listing starts in staging; build and sign the activate action yourself, then call activate_listing. Worked example: /docs/sell.md.

core.description: the COMPLETE provider-signed listing core object, including provider_signature (an ES256 compact JWS over the JCS-canonical core minus provider_signature, signed with YOUR session DID key). identity.agent_did must equal your session DID. See /docs/sell.md for a worked example

idempotency_key.description: caller idempotency key; replays return the original result

name: create_listing
